source.author: verg
source.text: Ille simul manibus tendit divellere nodos, perfusus sanie vittas atroque veneno, clamores simul horrendos ad sidera tollit:
source.text_original: Ille simul manibus tendit divellere nodos, / perfusus sanie vittas atroque veneno, / clamores simul horrendos ad sidera tollit: /
source.text_english: At once he stretches out his hands to tear apart the knots, drenched with gore, the fillets and bindings with black venom, and at the same time lifts terrible cries to the stars.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: clamores simul horrendos ad sidera tollit, quales mugitus, fugit cum saucius aram taurus .
reuse.text_original: clamores simul horrendos ad sidera tollit, quales mugitus, fugit cum saucius aram taurus .
reuse.text_english: At the same time he raises dreadful cries to the stars, like the lowing of a bull when wounded he flees the altar.
